name: Tribune Lucius
notes: AC 15 (studded leather). Tribune. Arrives Session 1. Performing confidence as protection.
gm_notes: Brutus's illegitimate son. Mission: destroy the spear in a way that gives Brutus what he needs without anyone knowing Lucius was involved. Performing confidence -- it is his protection against being discovered as ordinary. Arrives Session 1 via the gate; Corvinus glances at the staircase twice before he arrives.
objective: Destroy the spear and give Brutus what he needs with zero evidence of involvement.
goal: Remain invisible in the political landscape of this operation.
agenda: Perform absolute confidence as armor against being seen as ordinary.
secret: Brutus's illegitimate son. His entire identity is constructed around this concealment.
